slot.brief: Solve a linear ODE dy/dx + P(x)y = Q(x) with a simple integrating factor (e.g. P = 1/x or 2/x type), and find the particular solution through a given point.

verdicts.working: Integrating factor $x^2$ gives $(x^2y)'=2x$, so $y=1+C/x^2$. From $y(1)=3$, $C=2$, hence $y(2)=3/2$.
